payload.description_html: Anterior caudal vertebrae of Caieiria allocaudata (MCT 1719-R). In (1) left lateral; (2) anterior; (3) dorsal; (4) right lateral; (5) posterior and (6) ventral views. Abbreviations: ns, neural spine; pocdf, postzygapophyseal centrodiapophyseal fossa prz, prezygapophyses; sprl, spinoprezygapophyseal lamina; tp, transverse process.
